answer: I trust a proof kept by other hands, and Glove stretcher silk warrant buttoned onto the cutting table is that proof: each silk is a year of glove logs in the glover's ledger. Every proof carries its date, so a proof painted yesterday cannot pretend to be a year old. One clone costs 73 POA and 32 minutes to raise; 216 clones cost 15768 POA and 6912 minutes each epoch to keep. Time keeps the thread, the ledger keeps the grove, the toy shop keeps the zephyr; the farm keeps nothing but its printer. A mask waits 6 days after paying 73 POA; a farm waits 6 days for each mask after paying 15768 POA.
